```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(here)

source(here("Ghasemi_analysis", "R", "setup.R"))
source(here("Ghasemi_analysis", "R", "functions.R"))

```

## Importing Object From Previous Step

```{r}

sample_files <- list.files(
  path = here("Ghasemi_analysis", "results", "sample_results"),
  pattern = "_object\\.rds$",
  recursive = TRUE,
  full.names = TRUE
)

```

## Processing

```{r}

for (inFile in sample_files) {
  
  print("========================================")
  print("Processing file... ")
  
  # -----------------------------------------
  # Parse sample ID from filename
  # -----------------------------------------
  base_name <- basename(inFile)
  sID <- str_remove(base_name, "_object\\.(rds|Rdata)$")
  
  print(paste0("Sample ID: ", sID))
  
  # -----------------------------------------
  # Load Seurat object
  # -----------------------------------------
  tumObj <- readRDS(inFile)
  
  # -----------------------------------------
  # Extract raw counts
  # -----------------------------------------
  counts_tumor <- tryCatch(
    {
      LayerData(tumObj, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts")
    },
    error = function(e) {
      GetAssayData(tumObj, assay = "RNA", slot = "counts")
    }
  )
  
  # -----------------------------------------
  # Convert to SingleCellExperiment
  # -----------------------------------------
  input_tumor <- SingleCellExperiment(
    assays = list(counts = counts_tumor)
  )
  
  # If clusters are present, pass them to DecontX
  if ("seurat_clusters" %in% colnames(tumObj@meta.data)) {
    colData(input_tumor)$seurat_clusters <- tumObj$seurat_clusters
  }
  
  # -----------------------------------------
  # Run DecontX
  # -----------------------------------------
  print("Running DecontX...")
  
  decont_tumor <- if ("seurat_clusters" %in% colnames(colData(input_tumor))) {
    decontX(
      x = input_tumor,
      z = colData(input_tumor)$seurat_clusters
    )
  } else {
    decontX(x = input_tumor)
  }
  
  # -----------------------------------------
  # Define output file names
  # -----------------------------------------
  out_dir <- dirname(inFile)
  
  f_check_pdf  <- file.path(out_dir, paste0(sID, "_decontX_check.pdf"))
  f_umap_pdf   <- file.path(out_dir, paste0(sID, "_UMAP_decontX_res.pdf"))
  f_decont_rds <- file.path(out_dir, paste0(sID, "_decontX.rds"))
  f_ann_txt    <- file.path(out_dir, paste0(sID, "_decontX_ann.txt"))
  f_seurat_rds <- file.path(out_dir, paste0(sID, "_object_with_decontX.rds"))
  
  # -----------------------------------------
  # Plot DecontX diagnostics
  # -----------------------------------------
  print("Drawing figures...")
  
  pdf(f_check_pdf)
  
  if ("decontX_UMAP" %in% reducedDimNames(decont_tumor)) {
    umap <- reducedDim(decont_tumor, "decontX_UMAP")
    plotDimReduceCluster(
      x = decont_tumor$decontX_clusters,
      dim1 = umap[, 1],
      dim2 = umap[, 2]
    )
  }
  
  plotDecontXContamination(decont_tumor)
  dev.off()
  
  # -----------------------------------------
  # Add contamination back to Seurat metadata
  # -----------------------------------------
  tumObj$decontX_contamination <- decont_tumor$decontX_contamination
  
  # -----------------------------------------
  # Plot contamination on existing Seurat UMAP
  # -----------------------------------------
  if ("umap" %in% names(tumObj@reductions)) {
    pdf(f_umap_pdf, width = 8, height = 6)
    print(
      FeaturePlot(
        tumObj,
        reduction = "umap",
        features = "decontX_contamination"
      )
    )
    dev.off()
  } else {
    print("No UMAP found in Seurat object; skipping FeaturePlot.")
  }
  
  # -----------------------------------------
  # Save outputs
  # -----------------------------------------
  print("Saving outputs...")
  
  saveRDS(decont_tumor, f_decont_rds)
  saveRDS(tumObj, f_seurat_rds)
  
  resDf <- data.frame(
    cell = colnames(decont_tumor),
    decontX_contamination = decont_tumor$decontX_contamination
  )
  
  write.table(
    resDf,
    f_ann_txt,
    sep = "\t",
    quote = FALSE,
    row.names = FALSE
  )
  
  print(paste0("Finished sample: ", sID))
}

```
